title: Update a score
statementMd:
A teacher re-graded: add 5 points (capped at 100) to every score in course 1 using `MIN(100, score + 5)`, then show the new average for course 1 rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `new_avg`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `UPDATE enrollments SET score = MIN(100, score + 5) WHERE course_id = 1`.
solutionMd:
```sql
UPDATE enrollments SET score = MIN(100, score + 5) WHERE course_id = 1; SELECT ROUND(AVG(score), 2) AS new_avg FROM enrollments WHERE course_id = 1;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
